Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This is a recorded statement regarding the parking lot
collision in Baytown. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just go by my first name for now, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe what you were doing when the collision happened?
A: I was backing out of a space near the store entrance. I'd checked my mirrors and didn't see anything, but the other
vehicle came around the end of the row a little faster than I expected.
Q: How fast would you estimate the other vehicle was moving?
A: Honestly, not very fast, maybe a slow roll. But it was enough to catch my rear bumper and push me back a couple
of feet.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt at the time?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Did you feel any immediate injury after the impact?
A: Not right away. I was a bit shaken, but I got out and walked around. By that evening my neck was stiff and turning
my head hurt.
Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the next day. They diagnosed whiplash and told me to rest, take anti-inflammatory
medication, and do some gentle stretching. I've also been seeing a physical therapist twice a week.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?
A: Yes, I still get headaches and some stiffness, especially in the mornings. Sitting in the car for long stretches
bothers me too.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Just that I want to make sure my vehicle repairs and medical bills get handled properly. Thank you for listening.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>
